title: Deeper/broader versioned ACIS writer lifecycle and strict peer evidence
mode: primary-source web research and read-only local plan/source reconciliation
scope: Refresh ACadSharp modeler writer issue and pull-request states, including the post-refactor ACDSDATA readback report
Cross-check recent peer DXF writer, SPLINE, MTEXT, and transform reports against existing libdxfrw plan owners
Reconcile FreeCAD's current DWG converter route and refine only the existing PAR-07/S8 composed gate

sources.observation: Issue #1195 reports silent modeler-entity omission in ACadSharp 3.4.9. PR #1150 describes version-specific SAT/SAB placement, reports author-run TrueView checks for selected target versions, and later reports a post-refactor DXF ACDSDATA readback that retained only the last repeated group-310 chunk. PR #1174's page still displays Open while the #1150 discussion says the refactor was in current master, so exact code identity must be bound before comparison. PR #1240 remains open and undeployed.
sources.limits: PR descriptions and author-reported native checks are not released behavior, independently reproduced results, or normative format evidence. No branch was fetched, built, or run.

sources.observation: The reports describe strict AutoCAD DXF rejection around CLASS/HATCH/DIMSTYLE output, an ARC/ELLIPSE transform discrepancy, whole-file AC1032 MTEXT frame-flag rejection, and DWG-to-DXF SPLINE output later rejected by GDAL. They are mapped to existing local owners; no new libdxfrw defect was established.
sources.limits: Issue reports are producer-, version-, and application-specific. The linked SPLINE archive was not downloaded; the text lacks the offending handle and an independent expected curve.

sources.observation: The current ODA adapter requests ACAD2000 DXF and accepts output based on path existence without checking the child process return code. DWG then flows through a separately selected DXF importer; the published docs state stock FreeCAD does not read ACIS/SAT solid payloads.
sources.limits: Mutable source and archived documentation describe route behavior only. No FreeCAD build, converter, importer, or native platform was executed.

sources.observation: The existing plan already separates carrier bytes, versioned record placement, AcDs owner/key joins, strict external reopen, ACIS semantics, and native consumer evidence. Existing generated test owners cover multiple version/encoding routes; this pass specifies conditional coverage checks for repeated group-310 reconstruction and out-of-order owner/directory ordering rather than adding duplicate tests by default.
sources.limits: No local build or test was run. This research does not establish current native acceptance or complete ACIS/AcDs semantics.

planImpact.implementationSummary: Refined the existing PAR-07/S8 gate into a versioned carrier-and-association proof sequence, identified repeated group-310 reconstruction and non-monotonic owner/directory ordering as conditional coverage-audit points, and restated exact FreeCAD converter/importer limits. No local defect was established.

method.limitations: This update is based on mutable public source and issue/PR pages plus local read-only reconciliation. It does not reproduce peer failures or qualify a local/native route.

validation.commitBlocker: No commit was requested; the worktree has extensive pre-existing user changes and Git metadata is read-only in this session.
